candidates.name: LaForce (Milwaukee office)
candidates.partition_evidence: The Building Specialties page lists toilet partitions in several materials, shower and dressing compartments, and partition hardware for all manufacturers. The install page covers commercial door and frame installation only. No page says LaForce installs partitions.
red_flags: Large commercial door and hardware distributor; partition installation not shown
Brands listed are door-hardware partners, not partition makers
candidates.reason: LaForce is a commercial Division 10 and door supplier with a Milwaukee office in Menomonee Falls and its own install crews for doors and frames. It sells toilet partitions, but no page shows it installing them, so this is unproven. It is also a competing partitions seller.

candidates.name: Solid Partitions
candidates.partition_evidence: It manufactures its own partitions with custom CNC work, in headrail-braced, floor-to-ceiling and ceiling-hung styles, and supplies them to architects and designers. Its only featured project (Lake Country DockHounds) says it 'manufactured' the partitions, not that it installed them. The site offers installation instructions only.
red_flags: Manufactures and sells its own partitions (direct competitor and buy-around risk)
candidates.reason: Solid Partitions is a local partition manufacturer and supplier, not an installer. Its site shows no installation service, and it competes directly with Next Partitions on product.

candidates.name: Best Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: It supplies Division 10 products: toilet partition hardware, washroom accessories, fire extinguishers and cabinets, and lockers. It offers a downloadable partition installation instructions sheet. No installation service is stated.
red_flags: Supplier of Division 10 products and partition hardware; no installation service shown
No company email on the site
candidates.reason: Best Specialties is a Milwaukee supplier of Division 10 specialties and partition hardware. Neither page read says it installs partitions or accessories, so there is no evidence it does installation work.

candidates.name: Syncro Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: No website or listing found. Three searches turned up no Milwaukee or Wisconsin business by this name in partitions or Division 10.
red_flags: Could not confirm the business exists
candidates.reason: Three searches found no business named Syncro Inc in Milwaukee or Wisconsin connected to partitions or Division 10 work, so it can't be verified.
